subject: DI01000091

body.en:
Understand the idea

The syllabus calls command,function,trigger and control blocks;Scratch shapes explain how they connect.

Explanation and application

  • Command/stack blocks do actions;rounded function/reporters return values;Boolean reporters return conditions.
  • Trigger/hat blocks begin scripts;C-shaped controls contain nested actions.Some cap blocks end a stack.
  • Category colour is helpful,butshape/input compatibility and execution meaning are more important than memorising colour alone.
Does move10always mean y increases10?

No.It follows current heading rather than a fixed stage axis.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Syllabus command,function,trigger/control blocks કહે છે.Scratch shapes connections સમજાવે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Command/stack blocks actions કરે છે;rounded function/reporters values તથા Boolean reporters conditions આપે છે.
  • Trigger/hat scripts શરૂ કરે છે;C-shaped controls nested actions રાખે છે.અમુક cap blocks stack પૂરો કરે છે.
  • Category colour મદદરૂપ છે,પણ shape/input compatibility તથા execution meaning colour યાદ કરવા કરતાં વધુ મહત્વનાં છે.
move10થી હંમેશાં y10વધે?

ના.તે fixed axis નહિ,current heading અનુસરે છે.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Stage coordinates are fixed axes,while move steps follows the current sprite heading.

Explanation and application

  • go to chooses an immediate coordinate/target;glide to moves over a specified time;set x to/set y to assign one coordinate.
  • change x by and change y by shift along fixed axes;move steps follows heading,so forward is not always upward.
  • point in direction sets a heading;point towards aims at a target;turn clockwise/anticlockwise changes heading by an angle.
  • set rotation style controls visual rotation,not the mathematical meaning of x,y or heading.Initialise before drawing and keep coordinates within the stage when required.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Stage coordinates fixed axes છે,જ્યારે move steps current heading અનુસરે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • go to immediate coordinate/target લે છે;glide to specified timeમાં move કરે છે;set x to/set y to એક coordinate assign કરે છે.
  • change x by/change y by fixed axesમાં shift કરે છે;move steps heading મુજબ છે,એટલે forward હંમેશાં upward નહિ.
  • point in direction heading સેટ કરે;point towards target તરફ aim કરે;clockwise/anticlockwise turn heading angleથી બદલે છે.
  • set rotation style visual rotation control કરે છે,x,y/headingનો અર્થ નહિ.Drawing પહેલાં initialise કરો તથા જરૂર મુજબ stage boundsમાં રહો.

h.en: Pen is an extension with persistent marks
h.gu: Pen Extension Persistent Marks રાખે છે

body.en:
Understand the idea

Add the Pen extension before using its blocks;pen state and sprite state must both be managed.

Explanation and application

  • pen down starts drawing during motion;pen up permits repositioning without a joining line.
  • set pen colour to changes future ink;set pen size to sets stroke width;erase all removes pen marks and stamps,not sprite objects.
  • stamp leaves an image impression of the current sprite costume;it is not a new independently scripted sprite.
  • Rectangle turns use90degrees;regular polygon exterior turn is360/n,not the interior angle.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Pen blocks પહેલાં Pen extension ઉમેરો.Pen તથા sprite state બંને manage કરો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • pen down motion દરમિયાન drawing શરૂ કરે;pen up joining line વગર reposition કરવા દે છે.
  • set pen colour to future ink બદલે;set pen size to stroke width સેટ કરે;erase all marks/stamps દૂર કરે,sprites નહિ.
  • stamp current costumeની impression મૂકે છે;નવો independently scripted sprite નથી.
  • Rectangle turns90degrees છે;regular polygon exterior turn360/n છે,interior angle નહિ.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Looks blocks change presentation;they do not automatically change algorithmic data.

Explanation and application

  • say and think display speech/thought bubbles;choose a timed or persistent version according to the task.
  • switch costume to and next costume change a sprite image;switch backdrop to and next backdrop change the stage background.
  • change size by adds a percentage-point change to the sprite size setting;set size to assigns the target percentage.
  • change effect by,set effect to and clear graphic effects manage visual effects;show/hide controls sprite visibility,not whether every script stops.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Looks blocks presentation બદલે છે;algorithmic data આપોઆપ નહિ.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • say/think speech/thought bubbles બતાવે છે.Task મુજબ timed/persistent version લો.
  • switch costume to/next costume sprite image તથા switch backdrop to/next backdrop stage background બદલે છે.
  • change size by size settingમાં percentage-point change ઉમેરે છે;set size to target percentage assign કરે છે.
  • change effect by,set effect to/clear graphic effects visual effects manage કરે છે.Show/hide visibility control કરે છે;દરેક script બંધ થતી નથી.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Sound blocks depend on available assets,audio permission and the chosen execution behaviour.

Explanation and application

  • play sound until done waits for completion;start sound continues the stack and may overlap other activity.
  • stop all sounds stops playback;change pitch effect by,set pitch effect to and clear sound effects manage audio effects.
  • change volume by adjusts the setting;set volume to assigns it.Use sensible listening levels and clear/reset effects when the task requires it.
  • If a syllabus/older interface says stop sound,check the available current stop-all-sounds block rather than inventing a per-file command.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Sound blocks assets,audio permission તથા execution behaviour પર આધારિત છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • play sound until done completion સુધી રાહ જુએ;start sound stack આગળ ચલાવે તથા overlap થઈ શકે.
  • stop all sounds playback બંધ કરે;change pitch effect by,set pitch effect to/clear sound effects audio effects manage કરે છે.
  • change volume by setting adjust કરે;set volume to assign કરે છે.Sensible volume રાખો તથા જરૂર મુજબ effects reset કરો.
  • Syllabus/જૂના interfaceમાં stop sound હોય તો current stop-all-sounds block જુઓ;per-file command invent ન કરો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

The practice bundle contains an original short tone for lawful audio exercises;native audio playback is a learner test,not a claimed result.

Explanation and application

  • Import Practice-Tone.wav into the selected sprite Sounds area using the approved editor.
  • Compare play sound until done followed by say done with start sound followed by say done;listen and inspect the ordering.
  • Practise pitch/volume changes,clear effects and stop all sounds at a safe volume.Reset settings before comparing another run.
Does hide stop all scripts?

No.It hides appearance;script execution can continue.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Practice bundleમાં original short tone છે.Native audio playback learner test છે,claimed result નહિ.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Approved editorથી selected spriteના Soundsમાં Practice-Tone.wav import કરો.
  • play sound until done પછી say done તથા start sound પછી say done compare કરો.Ordering સાંભળી/જોઈ તપાસો.
  • Safe volumeએ pitch/volume changes,clear effects તથા stop all sounds શીખો.બીજા run પહેલાં settings reset કરો.
hideથી Scripts બંધ થાય?

ના.તે appearance છુપાવે છે;execution ચાલુ રહી શકે.

Aim and source duration

Use repeat2 with width,height and90degree turns;pen up before the centred start.

2 hours as listed;see syllabus-total discrepancy.

Tools and preconditions

Use the approved application/version and fictional sample data.Authorisation is required for installation,sharing and any real distribution.Never include passwords or private identifiers in evidence.

Procedure and checks

  1. Open the supplied .sb3 or assemble the same blocks in the approved Scratch editor.Select the intended sprite.
  2. Identify inputs,outputs,variables/lists and initial state before running.
  3. Use repeat2 with width,height and90degree turns;pen up before the centred start.
  4. Press green flag and enter only the planned test inputs;stop the project if behaviour is unexpected.
  5. Width1..400,height1..300keep this centred rectangle on stage;verify closure for100by60.
  6. Repeat with a boundary/invalid case and a second fresh run.Save the editable project and actual evidence,not prefilled execution claims.

Tools:approved Scratch3 browser/desktop editor;Pen extension for18–21.Local .sb3 editing does not require publishing an account project.

Readable block transcription

Open the native project for editable real Scratch blocks;this text is an explanatory transcription.

when green flag clicked
delete all results/items
askandwait Width (1..400) / Width
setvariableto w, answer()
if not(and(equals(w, add(w, 0)), and(not(lt(w, 1)), not(gt(w, 400)))))
  say Invalid input / અમાન્ય Input
  stop this script
end
askandwait Height (1..300) / Height
setvariableto h, answer()
if not(and(equals(h, add(h, 0)), and(not(lt(h, 1)), not(gt(h, 300)))))
  say Invalid input / અમાન્ય Input
  stop this script
end
pen clear
pen penUp
gotoxy 0, 0
pointindirection 90
pen setPenSizeTo 2
gotoxy divide(subtract(0, w), 2), divide(subtract(0, h), 2)
pen penDown
repeat 2
  movesteps w
  turnleft 90
  movesteps h
  turnleft 90
end
pen penUp

Download native Scratch .sb3

Actual evidence and fault finding

Record what actually happened.Check wrong selection,permissions,missing initialisation,input/range errors and version differences before repeating.Do not claim that supplied expected values are measured/performed results.

Input / ActionExpected checkActual resultEvidence / Notes

————
————
